annotation.justification: The clause provides clear guidance on the optional actions an endpoint may take when handling PATH_CHALLENGE frames. The use of 'MAY' indicates that the endpoint has discretion in rate-limiting PATH_RESPONSE frames and in discarding PATH_CHALLENGE frames. There is no language that permits multiple materially different interpretations or missing constraints that would affect implementation behavior.
